definitions.gloss: feeling of discomfort; unpleasant feeling; displeasure
definitions.explanation: An unpleasant or uncomfortable sensation, whether physical (nausea, irritation) or emotional (annoyance, displeasure). Composed of 不快 (unpleasant) + 感 (feeling).

examples.english: I feel discomfort in my stomach.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不快感|ふかいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people felt displeasure at that attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不快感|ふかいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: You may feel discomfort in your throat as a side effect of the medication.

notes:
USAGE:
{不快感|ふかいかん} can describe both physical discomfort (medical contexts) and emotional displeasure (social contexts). It is commonly used in formal or written language.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不快感|ふかいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (feel discomfort)
- {不快感|ふかいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (sense discomfort)
- {不快感|ふかいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧ (cause discomfort to others)
- {不快感|ふかいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ (show displeasure)
- ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧{不快感|ふかいかん} (mild discomfort)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{嫌悪感|けんおかん}→嫌悪感：15749_kenokan⟧ is stronger — it means "revulsion" or "disgust" rather than mere discomfort. ⟦{違和感|いわかん}→違和感：06249_iwakan⟧ means a sense that something is off or doesn't feel right, which is more cognitive than physical.
